verdict.rationale: The firm's own immigrant-visa page says qualifying family members may receive "derivative" Green Cards alongside the principal, so family coverage is documented for permanent residency. Nothing addresses nonimmigrant dependent visas such as O-3 or H-4, or spousal work authorization. Missing for 10: O-3 dependent documentation, H-4 dependent documentation, dependent/spousal work authorization (EAD) coverage, explicit statement that dependent filings are included in the founder service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service

citations.quote: In addition to the principal immigrant (e.g. the individual sponsored by his/her employer), qualifying family members may receive "derivative" Green Cards.
